roots.sql: select "projects"."id", "project_worktrees"."root_kind", "project_sources"."absolute_path", "project_worktrees"."worker_id", "project_worktrees"."id", "project_worktrees"."absolute_path" from "project_worktrees" inner join "project_sources" on "project_sources"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "project_sources"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where ("project_worktrees"."worker_id" = $2 and "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state" = $3 and "project_sources"."removed_at" is null) order by "project_worktrees"."created_at" asc limit $4

thread.sql: select "chat_runtime_sessions"."chat_id" from "chat_runtime_sessions" inner join "chats" on "chats"."id" = "chat_runtime_sessions"."chat_id" where ("chats"."owner_id" = $1 and "chat_runtime_sessions"."worker_id" = $2 and "chat_runtime_sessions"."codex_thread_id" = $3 and "chats"."archived_at" is null)
